rules.statement: Relic scope: 157 figure collections, five Relics each; 785 figure-linked + 115 originals + 40 beast + 20 folklore = 960.
rules.source: Recovered master registry Pass 46, summary tables

rules.statement: Source recovery, canon approval, visual approval, modeling, rigging, engine integration and playtesting are separate measures.
Approved artifact references must be preserved; replacements require explicit review and a supersession record.
Relic identities and registered names must be preserved; permitted shared identities require specific documented exceptions.
rules.source: Recovered master registry Pass 46, shared identity table

rules.statement: Proposed production measurements must remain distinct from authenticated historical evidence.
A completed or tested production item must include inspectable evidence; a concept image is not a game-ready asset.

reference_register.reason: Resolve the exact approved visual master using approval evidence; preserve its anatomy, colors and silhouette rather than relying on older text summaries.
